title: Concept: Individual gem source over cleartext
description: Gemfile declares a per-gem `source` URL over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a per-gem `source` URL over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile (rubygems).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a per-gem `source` URL over cleartext.
